userLatestRead: Discord playtester TuloWodash reported that hovering pets is buggy when the pet dock sits down on top of the grass board.
currentGoal: Prevent board/tile hover from stealing hover state while the pointer is over docked or placed world objects.

changesMade.summary: Board hover now checks visible docked and placed world-object bounds first. When the pointer is over one, tile hover is cleared without clearing the world-object info panel.
Added a tile-only hover cleanup helper so tile hover marker/release logic can run without wiping hoveredWorldObjectId.

verificationRun.result: passed visually; hovering bottom-docked Field Mouse and Meadow Rabbit showed their world-object panels instead of tile hover stealing the state.

currentGitStatus: Gameplay changes are local and uncommitted.
Placement UX and fast-click grass visual changes from previous handoffs are still local and uncommitted.
Pre-existing unrelated tracked edits remain in AGENTS.md and docs/DESKTOP_MAC_SYNC_WORKFLOW.md.
Pre-existing unrelated untracked docs/media/test handoff files remain untouched.
knownIssuesAndRisks: This fixes hover routing while the dock overlaps the board. It does not redesign the dock placement itself.
World-object bounds are checked every desktop pointer hover tick, but the list is tiny and the normal hover throttle still applies.
nextRecommendedSteps: Playtest the bottom pet dock in a normal save with the board expanded enough that pets overlap grass.
If the user wants this shipped, stage only the intended gameplay/handoff files and leave unrelated dirty docs/media alone.
doNotRevert: Do not replace clearTileHover with clearTileInfo in the world-object hover guard; that would clear hoveredWorldObjectId and bring the bug back.
